[[Single-issue politics]] | position = | headquarters = | website = {{URL|https://palfree.nz/}} }} The '''Free Palestine''' or '''Palestine Free from the River to the Sea Party''' is a registered political party in New Zealand. The party seeks to highlight and support the Palestinian cause in the [[2026 New Zealand general election]].{{cite web |url=https://yaffaps.com/en/page-114472.html |title=Founder of New Zealand’s “Free Palestine” Party calls for accountability over Gaza |publisher=Yaffa News Network |date=12 July 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}}{{cite web |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/interview-new-zealands-free-palestine-party-aims-to-turn-solidarity-movement-into-political-force/3983341 |title=INTERVIEW – New Zealand's Free Palestine Party aims to turn solidarity movement into political force |publisher=Anadolu New Zealand |author=Saadet Gokce |date=1 July 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}} It is led by Paul Hopkinson, a schoolteacher who [[Hopkinson v Police|burnt a New Zealand flag in 2004]] and serves as an affiliate to the [[Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine]], while also being the national leader of the Palestine Solidarity Campaign and an ex-member of the revolutionary socialist [[Workers Party of New Zealand]]{{Cite web |last=Aotearoa |first=RNZ {{!}} Te Reo Irirangi o |date=2008-09-26 |title=Election candidate suspended from teaching role |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/regions/29707/election-candidate-suspended-from-teaching-role |access-date=2026-09-28 |website=RNZ |language=en-nz}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.newarab.com/news/new-zealands-free-palestine-party-seeks-put-gaza-centre |title=New Zealand's Free Palestine Party seeks to put Gaza at centre of election debate |publisher=The New Arab |author=Ibrahim Othman |date=22 June 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}}{{Cite web |title=Concerns over meeting to launch 'terrorist group' campaign |url=https://www.odt.co.nz/canterbury/christchurch/concerns-over-meeting-to-launch-terrorist-group-campaign-jbf1s547 |access-date=2026-09-17 |website=www.odt.co.nz |language=en}}{{cite web |url=https://www.jpost.com/diaspora/antisemitism/article-898896 |title=Free Palestine party seeks to finalize registry for New Zealand elections |publisher=Jeruslaem Post |author=Michael Starr |date=9 June 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}} == History == The party was founded in May 2026. In May the Electoral Commission allocated the party $78,887 in broadcasting funding, contingent upon its registration.{{cite web |url=https://elections.nz/media-and-news/2026/2026-broadcasting-allocation-decision |title=2026 Broadcasting allocation decision |publisher=Electoral Commission |date=7 May 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}}{{cite web |url=https://www.spectator.com.au/2026/06/nzs-latest-party-hates-israel/ |title=NZ’s latest party hates Israel |publisher=The Spectator (Australia) |author=Juliet Moses |date=6 June 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}} The party applied for registration in June 2026.{{cite web |url=https://elections.nz/media-and-news/2026/another-party-applies-to-register |title=Another party applies to register |publisher=New Zealand Electoral Commission |date=22 June 2026 |access-date=19 July 2026}} The party was registered on 5 August 2026, but its proposed logo was declined.{{cite web |url=https://elections.nz/media-and-news/2026/decisions-on-party-registrations-and-logos |title=Decisions on party registrations and logos |publisher=New Zealand Electoral Commission |date=5 August 2026 |access-date=5 August 2026}}{{cite web |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/politics/election-2026-mariameno-kapa-kingis-new-party-approved-by-electoral-commission/DFSW2HKZVNDQZJPMGELK3NP3AY/ |title=Election 2026: Mariameno Kapa-Kingi’s new party approved by Electoral Commission |publisher=New Zealand Herald |author=Julia Gabel |date=5 August 2026 |access-date=6 August 2026}} == Policy == The Free Palestine Party supports a [[One-state solution#The left|one-state solution]] to the [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], and opposes [[Zionism]].{{Cite web |title=Palestine Free from the River to the Sea Party |url=https://palfree.nz/#objectives |access-date=2026-09-29 |website=palfree.nz}} However, it seeks to "unite... supporters of Palestine from all traditions"{{Cite web |title=Palestine Free from the River to the Sea Party |url=https://palfree.nz/#objectives |access-date=2026-09-29 |website=palfree.nz}} (e.g. [[Hamas|Islamism]], [[Fatah|Ba'athism]], etc).
